notes.title: = 9.10 Version Update Announcement =
notes.notes:
Dear Commanders,
This week's update is packed with exciting content! Miya knows you have been waiting eagerly, so let's get straight to the good stuff!

[b]=Major Upgrade · Visual Feast=[/b]
[u]The "All Angels Evolution" project is complete![/u]
The models of all the Angels who have been accompanying you have undergone a comprehensive remaster and upgrade! Everything, from their movements to the finest details, has been completely revamped!
[u]A/B/C-tier Angels · Revamped characters Art Debuts![/u]
We have also replaced and optimized the character art for Angels of the corresponding tiers. Both their appearance and temperament have been greatly enhanced!

To this day, Angel Legion is able to shine even more brilliantly, and this would not have been possible without every Commander who has accompanied and supported us along the way! (Miya is sending a thousand manual heartfelt thanks here ❤)

Please look forward to tomorrow's new version and witness the brand-new charm of the Angels with your own eyes! See you in the game!

Below is the official update preview for all commanders to review.
[b]=Maintenance Time=[/b]
[u]September 10, 14:00 - 16:00 (GMT+8)[/u]

[b]=Maintenance Compensation=[/b]
Diamonds*300

[b]=Important Notes=[/b]
1. Please close the game and download the latest game file after the maintenance starts.
2. Commander need to download and install the latest version of the game package on Store.
3. After you successfully install the latest game file, wait for the maintenance to end and you can play normally.

[b]=Feature Adjustment=[/b]
1. Upgraded the models of all heroes; fully replaced the art for A-tier, B-tier, and C-tier heroes.
2. Adjusted the hero details interface and added a new "Senki" tab, which will include appearance and story functions.
3. Adjusted the display of story dialogues, added interactive storylines, and applied dynamic character art for dialogue characters.
4. [u]Removed the fashion shop from Star Adventure. After the update, the Star Adventure maps and adventure events progress of all Commanders will be forcibly refreshed.[/u]
5. Unlocked the custom makeup function for all heroes.
6. Adjusted the animation effects during the recruitment process.
7. Enhanced the classification display of chat messages and supported adjusting the priority of notifications in settings.
8. Added an in-game volume adjustment function.
9. Adjusted the display of the pre-battle interface for the main storyline.
10. Adjusted the handling method for resource overflow to resolve the frequent overflow issue of Star Coupon and Force.

[b]=System Optimization=[/b]
1. Optimized model and scene resources to improve expressive quality.
2. Optimized the scene display of the pre-battle interface for the main storyline.
3. Optimized the display of Miya's promotion process.
4. Optimized the display of the hero transpose function.
5. Added higher-resolution setting options.

notes.title: 「Angel Legion」New Version Updated！

In the new「Endless Trial」, Miya team will go into a brand new star land!
[b]Massive rewards and exciting events are waiting to be unfold. [/b]ːsteamhappyː
During the exploration, commanders can collect various divine seals to enhance your power, to take down the enemies on the way and to conquer this new region! 

[previewyoutube=yaFE0RL7fHM;full][/previewyoutube]

【New Rules of Endless Trial】
1. The new endless trial is changed to season system. Every season stars on the 1st of the month and end up at 28th of the month.
2. Every 10 stages regarded as one area, commanders can enter the next area after passing the current area. And you can receive daily reward according to the highest arrival area in history.
3. There is a rank based on the highest challenge progress of each season. After the end of the season, ranking reward will be sent via mail according to the server ranking of commanders.
d) When new season starts, part of the challenge progress will be reset. (The highest progress in history remains.)
4. After endless trial updated, part of the progress and reward of all commanders in endless trial will be reset.

【Notice】
1. After endless trial updated, part of the progress and reward of all commanders in endless trial will be reset.
2. After endless trial updated, the makeup and hairstyle will be unlocked by passing the endless trial. The unlocked ones remain.

notes.title: ========Update Announcement========
notes.notes:
Dear commanders, 
The Angel Legion will be updated and maintained from 14:00 PM Dec 16th, 2021(GMT/UTC+8).
During the maintenance period, you will be temporarily unable to play the game. Please be prepared in advance. Sorry for any inconvenience.

Duration
About 2 Hours

Maintenance Compensation
Diamonds*300

TIPS
1. Please close the game and download the latest game file after the maintenance starts.
2. After you successfully install the latest game file, wait for the maintenance to end and you can play normally.

========What’s New========
Function Adjustment
1. Update of Endless Trial Gameplay
Miya team will go into a brand new star land, in which massive rewards and exciting events are waiting to be unfold. During the exploration, commanders can collect various divine seals to enhance your power, to take down the enemies on the way and to conquer this new region!
Rules of New Gameplay:
a) The new endless trial is changed to season system. Every season stars on the 1st of the month and end up at 28th of the month.
b) Every 10 stages regarded as one area, commanders can enter the next area after passing the current area. And you can receive daily reward according to the highest arrival area in history.
c) There is a rank based on the highest challenge progress of each season. After the end of the season, ranking reward will be sent via mail according to the server ranking of commanders.
d) When new season starts, part of the challenge progress will be reset. (The highest progress in history remains.)
2. After endless trial updated, part of the progress and reward of all commanders in endless trial will be reset.
3. After endless trial updated, the makeup and hairstyle will be unlocked by passing the endless trial. The unlocked ones remain.

System Optimization
1. Fixed the bug that wrong button status shown in events page, when purchase the item after reconnecting.
2. Fixed some bugs in the starry treasure event pool.
3. Fixed the bug, when gifting the fashion shard to friend, there is wrong info shown in receiver’s mail.
4. Fixed the bug in take photo function, the loading of icon.
5. Added the prompt of tapping the artifact icon on formation page in timed challenge.
6. Optimized part of interface layout.
7. Optimized part of the description text.

notes.title: ========Version Update Notice========
notes.notes:
Dear commanders, we will update the game version in the near future.

Preview of version update content
Function Adjustment
1.New cross server legion combat game play: Galaxy War
A)The legion leader and the deputy leader can start matching, a map will be generated based on the opponent matched.
B)The war zone map is a hexagonal grid map full of fog, which is the same shape as the map of Adventure.
C)Each legion member has a fixed number of action chances in each map. When rematching the opponent legion, the action chances will also be reset.
D)Each time a member explores the map, 1 action chance is consumed. The exploration could uncover the fog on the selected block and trigger elemental events under the fog, such as obtaining score, activating the temple, or discovering enemy ships, etc. Attacking enemy ship will consume 1 action chance.
E)Different scores can be obtained according to the event, and the scores of each member are finally summarized into the total scores of the legion.
F)Finally, the corresponding legion rewards will be issued according to the total scores ranking of the legion.

2.Added main quest progress ranking information.

System Optimization
1.Optimized the order of Fashions. When a new fashion is available, this fashion will be at the top.
2.Fixed a bug where you need to re-start the game to see the equipment after purchasing a Lv. 25 package.
3.The respawning of drift box will be shown in the Report in the adventure.
4.Fixed the bug that when there are three deputy leaders in the legion, one of them cannot be appointed as the leader of the legion.
5.You can check the information of unlocked items in the War Support store.
6.Changed the hairstyles of Flame Dancer and Bounty Hunter.
7.Beautify bust and avatar of Miya.
8.Optimized the event interface.
